name: ai-chat-reveal
title: AI Chat Reveal
description: A question is typed on a rising keyboard, sent, and answered by an AI that streams its reply word by word on a measured token rhythm - thinking dot, uneven bursts, bulleted list - before the app cuts to a branded closing card
author: Miao Yang

variables.label: Assistant name
variables.description: Name of the assistant answering in this mock chat. It belongs to the host product, never to the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: User message
variables.description: The question typed on the keyboard and sent. Around 40 characters keeps the measured pacing.
variables.default: How do I turn my HTML into real video?

variables.label: Answer paragraph 1
variables.description: First streamed paragraph. It names the brand this video promotes and says what that brand does.
variables.default: You do not need an editor. HyperFrames renders the HTML you already write into deterministic, pixel-perfect video.

variables.label: Answer paragraph 3
variables.default: What you get out of the box:

variables.label: Bullet 1
variables.default: A catalog of motion primitives you install and own

variables.label: Bullet 2
variables.default: GSAP timelines that seek to any frame

variables.label: Bullet 3
variables.default: 4K renders from a single CLI command

variables.label: End-card headline
variables.description: Closing card headline. A | breaks the line.

variables.label: End-card subline
variables.description: Positioning sentence of the brand this video promotes, on the closing card.
variables.default: Open-source video rendering — write HTML, ship pixel-perfect video.

variables.label: End-card CTA
variables.description: Closing-card button label, which names the brand this video promotes. Use the real name of that brand.

variables.label: End-card footer
variables.description: Domain of the brand this video promotes, letter-spaced at the very bottom. Use the real domain.

variables.label: Brand logo
variables.description: Transparent mark of the brand this video promotes, in the closing-card header.
